title: Foundation Starter
description: Build a solid base with fundamental movements. Perfect for first-timers who want to build confidence, mobility, and basic strength from the comfort of home.
features: Wall push-ups, assisted squats, glute bridges

title: Strength Builder
description: Level up with full bodyweight movements. Develop real pushing, pulling, and core strength while improving control and endurance.

title: Calisthenics Mastery
description: Master impressive skills and elite strength. Train toward the planche, front lever, muscle-up, and handstand push-up with structured progressions.
